translation.name: GOD ETER AGERKE NAMDERASEM TUMA YENBO

book.name: APOSEL
book.title: APOSEL Aposel tame eme kerebetem yaku.

content: Pol ere tewo pes wom, ere sene yin tuma wusowun sewurbetem, Timoti ere eterken kir yim.
Pol ere Derbe komke yin sene ere Listra komke yim. Yim, Kristen tame wuri eri sig Timoti, ere etek temenem. Eteri nawo te Juda ta, te Kristen tem. Eteri a ere Grik tame.
Listra komri Kristen tame, Aikoniam komri Kristen tame eme etep wom. Timoti ere tame yenbo.

Eke, Pol ere Timoti erne panen yite wom, ere erne Juda emri wulek tobom. Ere Timoti erne somo kwunem. Etek temenem, Juda tame eme metmenem, Timoti eri a ere Grik tame, etepkap Pol ere Timoti erne somo kwunem. Pol ere etep wom. Juda tame eme tuma mane wote. Etep wom.

Somo kwunen eme kom nogwapeke yim. Yim, eme wurare wurare komri Kristen tatame emne tuma wusowum. Jerusalemri aposel tame, Kristen lakere tame etemri wom tuma eme emne wusowum. Eme etep wom. Aposel emri wom wule kem sete. Etep wom.
Etep tem, Kristen eme kenake abom, kwokwos kwokwos Juda berai tatame eme Jisas erne kenawaike abobetem.
Pol ere Masedoniari tame emne lam.
Eme Frigia distrikken Galesia distrikken etek yim, God Eri Wou ere emne etep wom. Esia provinsri tatame emne God eteri tuma kem mane yin wusoute. Etep wom.
Eme Misia distrik mekinke yim, eme Bitiniak yite wom, Jisas Eri Wou ere emne sene wotakem.
Wotaken eme Misia distrik tewok teten Troas komke warem.
Etek temenem, neirke Pol ere nugsik tuknalabekap lam, ere etep lam. Masedonia provinsri tame wuri ere teten Pol erne etep wom. Ne gwo Masedoniak yan nemne kobo late.

Ere etep lam, aren Luk, an etemken temenem, nema abom, God ere nemne Masedonia komke won yite, nema God eri tuma yenbo Masedoniari tatame emne wusoute. Eke nema wos lokwo pakwon Masedonia provinske yim.
Lidia te Kristen tem.
Nema sip Troas komke peten Samotres sel keraruke wom. Wom, kwokwos nema Neapolis komke yim.
Yim, nema Neapolis mesginin nema Filipai komke wurim. Filipai kom ere Masedonia kom sag. Rom komri tame eme kiyi ete komke simenem. Etek wurim, yabel nogwape nema etek temenem.

Temenem, ege si yabelke nema kom mesginin peik barke yim. Nema etep abom. Juda eme God erken tuma etek namdete. Etep abom, eke nema etek yim. Yin lam, kau ta eme etek temenem, nema etek etemken sin emne tuma wusowum.

Wusowum, ta wuri teri sig Lidia, te ete tuma sin metem. Ete ta te Taiataira komri ta, te wolepai mate nabetem ta. Te God erne abobetem ta, Keryen ere tene porere yenbo newom, eke te Pol eri wom tuma te noub metem.

Metem, nema Lidia etetken etetri akeri tatame emne baptais ok wiruwum. Baptais ok wiruwum, te nemne etep wom. Kem etep metten, an Keryen God erne kenawaike abobe. Kem etep kir wote, kem yan areri akek tete. Etep wom, nema teri tuma meten etetri akek yin tem.
Polken Sailasken epe Filipai komri ake yaperke temenem.

Yabel wuri nema God erken tuma namdebe emik yibetem, nema yaku bepou me kerebe ta wuri tene lam. Ete ta tene gabo gulelemenem, yuri tete wos te wusoubetem. Te ete yaku kerebetem, tene lakerebetem tame eme kel nogwape petbetem.
Nema tene lam, te nemne Pol nage kin yekwok semowun noubke etepke tebetem. Ete tame eme Keryen God eteri yaku kerebe tame. God ere kemne sene pette, eke eme kemne ete tuma wusoube.

Etep wom, yabel nogwape etepwou wobetem, Pol ere mo won ere tene petkwo lan etek gulelemenem gabo erne etep wom. Gabo, an nene Jisas Krais eteri sigke wobe. Ne ete ta tene mesginin yi. Eri wobetem tuma tepken gabo ere tene mesginin yim.

Etetne lakerebetem tame eme etep lam, eme abolawoyin etep wom. Ta te teri yaku sene beke kip kere, nema nemri tokwo sene beke kip pet. Etep abolawoyim, eme Polken Sailasken epne keresukun litin yin kom sag borborke maklek tuma namdete yim, komri apeilake etemri bitimik tuma namdete yim.
Yim, ta tene lakerebetem tame eme Romri apeilake emne etep wom. Gwo tame epe Juda tame. Epe nemri kom ei nakwoseye.
Epe nemne akeite wule o tuma kir wusoube. Nemri wule e kena. Nema Romri tame, nema akeite wule beke kip se. Etep wom.
Tatame nogwape eme ete tuma metem, etem kir eme pap wayem. Tuma metbetem apeilake tame ere epri tame oub akei lug peten tatame emne etep wom. Kem paku peten epne pete.
Etep wom, eme epne paku kenake pen epne ake yaperke won wurim. Won wurim, eme ake yaper lakerebetem tame erne worwor noub etep wom. Ne epne noubwai lakerete. Epe kip amen yite wurken.
Etep wom, ake lakere tame ere epne ake purik remapite wurin lumken me eisau peten etepri tewok ragerkerem.
Neir borke, Polken Sailasken epe God eterken tuma namden sekwo lombetem, ake yaperke temenem tame eme sin me metbetem.
Metbetem, agetage nina eisau yam, ake ere poipayin ake eru eme akei latyewom, emne peikmenem kep akei roboyewom.

Roboyewom, ake lakerebetem tame ere tuknamenem, ere wayen teten lam, ake eru akei latyewomenem. Etep lam, ere etep abom. Ake eru latyewoye, ake yaperke tetan tame eme akei worakwuten yikwuteye. Eke ere eri buske yewomenem gapaku sogwu peten maime wak regen sate wom.
Kworere maime pen sate nenbetem, Pol ere etep lam, ere noubke etep wom. Ne mane kena pen sate. Nema akei gwo som tetan.
Ake lakere tame ere akeite tame erne tu wometem, ere tu peten ake purik amen wurim, ere sene aken poipayin Polken Sailasken etepri tewo tobok gulwarke pan sim.
Sene ere epne panen woran etep wom. Kep ane wusoute. An beke nente, God ere ane sene pette?
Epe erne awosein etep wom. Ne Aneyen Jisas erne kenawaike abote, God ere nene sene pette. Neri yentaken ere kir pette.
Etep womke, epe eteri akek temenem tatame emne Jisas eri tuma wusowum.
Neir som teketemenem, ake lakere tame ere epne magel naibetem emi bam. Sene epe eri yentaken emne baptais ok wiruwum.
Baptais ok wiruwum, Polken Sailasken epne ere eri akek panen wurin a newon am. Am, ere yentaken eme God erne kenawaike abon metekwasem.
Ei berakwunem, Romri apeilake eme nau se tame emne won yan ake lakerebetem tame erne etep wom. Ne epne sene won yite.
Etep metem, ere Pol erne etep wom. Apeilake eme kepne yite woye. Kep epe yi. Kep elen me yi.

Pol ere nau se tame emne etep wom. Eme lam, nesa be wos yaper beke wuri nen. Etep lam, eme nesetne tatame nogwape etemri bitimik pem. Eme etep nenem, etepkap yaper. Nesa Romri tame. Eme nesetne bepou me ake yaperke won wurim. Gwopte eme nesetne berasen won elen me yite woye, etepkap yaper. Nesa beke kip yi. Romri apeilake etem eme yan nesetne ake yaperke won yite, e yenbo.
Etep womke, nau se tame eme yin Romri apeilake emne Pol eri wom tumakap eme wusowum. Polken Sailasken epe Rom tame, eme etep metem, eme akem.
Akem, eme yin epne woyebo woyebo tuma won epne ake yaperke panen woran epne etep wom. Kep neremri kom mesginin epe yi.
Etep wom, epe ake yaper mesginin Lidia etetri akek yim. Yim, epe Kristen tame emne lan pap yenbo metbe tuma emne won epe ek yim.
